title: THE SPRINGS ARE THE NATURAL WORLD — 10 wonders mapped to science

hotSpring.domain: Computational plasma physics, lattice QCD, spectral theory
hotSpring.papers: Sarkas MD, TTM, nuclear EOS, SU(3) Wilson, Anderson localization
hotSpring.metaphor: The pressure beneath the earth. Heat that drives everything.
hotSpring.taq_corollary: Taq polymerase evolved in Yellowstone hot springs. The enzyme that makes PCR possible came from extreme heat. hotSpring proves computation can too.

wetSpring.natural_wonder: Deep-sea hydrothermal vents — black smokers, chemosynthesis
wetSpring.domain: Metagenomics, analytical chemistry, microbial ecology, PFAS
wetSpring.papers: 52/52 papers, Waters QS, Liu phylogenetics, Jones PFAS
wetSpring.metaphor: Life emerges from chemistry at the bottom of the ocean. No sunlight needed.
wetSpring.ferment: Fermentation IS wetSpring. Microbes transform substrate into product. The lab bench IS the vent.

airSpring.natural_wonder: The atmosphere — weather, evapotranspiration, the water cycle
airSpring.domain: Precision agriculture, FAO-56, Richards PDE, IoT sensors
airSpring.papers: 57 papers, FAO-56, Dong, Kumari, SCS-CN, Van Genuchten
airSpring.metaphor: Meteorology IS the air we breathe. The cycle that feeds the world.

neuralSpring.natural_wonder: The brain — neural architecture, learning, adaptation
neuralSpring.domain: ML primitives, transformers, structure prediction, coralForge
neuralSpring.papers: 25+ papers, isomorphism theorem, AlphaFold2/3, WDM surrogates
neuralSpring.metaphor: The mind IS the neural spring. Every thought IS a computation.

groundSpring.natural_wonder: Mountains and tectonic plates — measurement, uncertainty, deep structure
groundSpring.domain: Sensor noise, inverse problems, error propagation, spectral theory
groundSpring.papers: 21 experiments across 8 domains, Anderson, Hofstadter, Bazavov
groundSpring.metaphor: The ground beneath your feet. The uncertainty you must accept to know anything.

healthSpring.natural_wonder: The human body — pharmacokinetics, the gut, the heart
healthSpring.papers: 17 experiments, Gonzales G1-G6, Charles Mok TRT
healthSpring.metaphor: The body IS the health spring. Kevin's father IS the clinical anchor.

ludoSpring.natural_wonder: PLAY — the primrose path, the game, the joy
ludoSpring.domain: Game science, HCI, procedural generation, flow theory
ludoSpring.papers: 44 experiments, Fitts, Hick, Csikszentmihalyi, Perlin, WFC
ludoSpring.metaphor: PLAY IS the ludoSpring. The primrose. NP = FUN. You can't optimize fun.

coralForge.natural_wonder: Coral reefs — structural biology, protein folding, life architecture
coralForge.metaphor: The reef IS the structure. Life builds itself from geometry.

rustChip.natural_wonder: Silicon — neuromorphic computing, the chip IS the brain
rustChip.domain: AKD1000, NPU kernel drivers, ESN, cross-substrate inference
rustChip.papers: NPU characterization, ESN comparison, streaming pipeline
rustChip.metaphor: The silicon IS the rustChip. The brain on a chip. 2.8μs inference.

primalSpring.natural_wonder: The ecosystem itself — composition, orchestration, meta-spring
primalSpring.domain: Multi-node bonding, deploy graphs, ecosystem overwatch
primalSpring.metaphor: The spring that springs all springs. The meta. The orchestrator.
